text.p: The monetary meeting between Chancellor of the Exchequer Kenneth Clarke and Bank of England Governor Eddie George in Nottingham ended at around 1520 GMT.
The meeting had started at around 1430 GMT.
The monthly meeting, normally held at the Treasury in London, took place in Nottingham because of Clarke's election campaign commitments.
City economists expect no change in official interest rates from the present 6.0 percent.
It will not become clear until the first round of Bank of England money market operations at around 0845 GMT on Friday morning whether rates have been changed.
